from miniconf.loader import load
c=load('examples/service.conf');print(c.get('level',section='logging'),c.get('port',section='http'))
import tempfile,os
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
w=lambda n,t:open(os.path.join(d,n),'w').write(t)
w('a.conf','a=1\n@include b.conf\n');w('b.conf','@include a.conf\n');w('c.conf','@include nope\n');w('s.conf','@include s.conf\n')
for f in 'a','c','s':
    try: load(os.path.join(d,f+'.conf'))
    except ConfigError as e: print('ConfigError',e)
"
